claims.text: USPSTF: counsel young adults, adolescents, children and parents of young children about minimizing UV exposure, for persons aged 6 months to 24 years w fair skin
claims.quote: The USPSTF recommends counseling young adults, adolescents, children, and parents of young children about minimizing exposure to ultraviolet (UV) radiation for persons aged 6 months to 24 years with fair skin types to reduce their risk of skin cancer.
